"""Save each complete native guard terminal outside the guarded process tree."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

BASE = Path('docs/audits/raw-semantic-parent-closure-20261011')


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain first complete recovery record: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def instruments(command):
    names = {str(BASE / 'capture.py'), 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py',
             't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py'}
    names.update(arg for arg in command if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file())
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(names):
        raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
        try:
            body = dict(body=raw.decode('utf-8'))
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            body = dict(body_hex=raw.hex())
        result[name] = dict(**body, identity=pin(raw))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--expect', type=int, choices=(0, 1), default=0)
    parser.add_argument('label')
    parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command or not args.label or any(c not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-' for c in args.label):
        raise ValueError('explicit ordinary recovery gate and command')
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *args.command]
    epoch = instruments(args.command)
    folder = Path('.artifacts/raw-semantic-parent-closure-20261011/checks') / args.label
    # The public boundary checker validates the output route without creating it.
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery', 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
    recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
    recovery.local(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, expected_status=args.expect,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        condition='Complete native terminal writer outside unchanged guard; an expected refusal is not successful original replay.')
    save(args.label + '-started.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(),
                  programmes_after=instruments(args.command))
    save(args.label + '-actual.json', actual)
    print(args.label, 'actual native status', result.returncode, flush=True)

import argparse

import json

import re
import subprocess

PLAN = json.loads((BASE / 'plan.json').read_bytes())
OWNER, RAW, REVISION = (PLAN[k] for k in ('owner', 'raw', 'revision'))
TASK = 'docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md'
BOOK = 'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md'
REGISTRY = 'doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl'
CLOSE = (RAW + '.5.2', RAW + '.5.2.3', OWNER)
SUCCESS = 'PASS complete unchanged raw semantic parent acceptance; canonical and higher native/private scopes remain open.\n'
READERS = {
    'checkpoint-core': (['python3', '-B', PLAN['checkpoint'] + '/witness.py', '--core'],
        'PASS separate complete original-reader checkpoint core; publication remains required.\n'),
    'recovery-core': (['python3', '-B', PLAN['recovery'] + '/verify.py', '--core'],
        'PASS unchanged original reader before/after, complete source custody and permanent controls.\n'),
    'semantic-positive-v2': (['python3', '-B', 'docs/audits/raw-semantic-links-20261011/reader.py',
        'docs/audits/raw-semantic-links-20261011/candidate.json.gz'],
        'PASS independent complete original raw semantic links; inherited bodies and native/private limits conserve.\n')}
EXCLUDED = {'proof.json', 'manifest.json'} | {n + suffix for n in ('seal', 'default', 'staged-doctrines')
                                             for suffix in ('-started.json', '-actual.json')}


def need(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def read(name):
    return json.loads((BASE / name).read_bytes())


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own read-only Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def nodes(raw):
    matches = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n', raw, re.M))
    result = {m[1].decode(): raw[m.start():matches[i+1].start() if i+1 < len(matches) else len(raw)]
              for i, m in enumerate(matches)}
    need(len(result) == len(matches), 'unique complete original task node population')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1].decode() if match else None


def obligations():
    original = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    fixed = nodes(original)
    targets = {k: v for k, v in fixed.items() if k == RAW + '.5.2' or k.startswith(RAW + '.5.2.')}
    need(all(field(v, 'Status') == 'done' and field(v, 'Commit') not in (None, 'pending')
             for k, v in targets.items() if k not in CLOSE), 'every original completed descendant is committed')
    need(all(field(fixed[k], 'Status') == 'active' for k in CLOSE[:-1])
         and field(fixed[OWNER], 'Status') == 'pending', 'exact remaining original parent closure frontier')
    return dict(original=pin(original), nodes={k: {name: field(v, name) for name in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children')}
                                              for k, v in targets.items()})


def qualify_gate(row, label, command, stdout=None):
    need(type(row['status']) is int and row['status'] == 0 and type(row['expected_status']) is int
         and row['expected_status'] == 0, 'typed successful current gate ' + label)
    need(row['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command], 'exact current gate command ' + label)
    need(row['programmes'] == row['programmes_after'], 'complete current instrument epoch ' + label)
    for name, entry in row['programmes'].items():
        need(('body' in entry) != ('body_hex' in entry), 'lossless text or binary programme/input body')
        body = entry['body'].encode() if 'body' in entry else bytes.fromhex(entry['body_hex'])
        need(pin(body) == entry['identity'], 'complete actual programme/input bytes')
        if name == str(BASE / 'capture.py'):
            need(body in (Path(name).read_bytes(), (BASE / 'capture-first.py.txt').read_bytes()), 'explicit original or binary-safe writer epoch')
        elif name == TASK and label == 'root-history':
            dated = gzip.decompress((BASE / 'activation-task.md.gz').read_bytes()).decode()
            start = dated.index('- ID: `' + OWNER + '`\n')
            end = dated.index('\n- ID:', start + 1)
            finding = read('activation-failure.json')['finding']
            expected = dated[:end].rstrip() + '\n  Findings: `' + finding + '`\n' + dated[end:]
            need(body == expected.encode(), 'whole declared dated Git selector task snapshot')

            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole unchanged direct gate programme/input')
    need(re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', row['stderr']) is not None
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in row['stderr'], 'unchanged successful RAM guard')
    if stdout is not None:
        need(row['stdout'] == stdout and row['stderr'].count('\n') == 1, 'whole intended current gate success ' + label)


def gate(label, command, stdout=None):
    row = read(label + '-actual.json')
    started = read(label + '-started.json')
    need(all(row[k] == value for k, value in started.items()), 'whole actual started declaration')
    qualify_gate(row, label, command, stdout)
    return row


def join(candidate, source, contracts):
    need(candidate['source'] == source, 'complete original source join')
    need(candidate['contracts'] == contracts, 'every unchanged original parent and descendant obligation')
    need(candidate['native'].keys() == READERS.keys(), 'complete current qualification role allocation')
    for name, (command, stdout) in READERS.items():
        qualify_gate(candidate['native'][name], name, command, stdout)


def core():
    source = intake.derive()
    need(source == read('intake-first.json') == read('intake-after.json'), 'whole original source/native/product Git custody before and after reconstruction')
    contracts = obligations()
    rows = {name: gate(name, *spec) for name, spec in READERS.items()}
    for role in ('first', 'after'):
        gate('source-' + role, ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--' + role],
             'PASS complete unchanged original source, mode, file/directory and committed evidence custody.\n')
    history = gate('root-history', ['git', 'log', '-1', '-S', 'Join every complete original raw-stack meaning',
                                  '--format=%H %s', '--', TASK])
    need(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40} .+\n', history['stdout']) is not None, 'actual original acceptance history locus')
    first = read('binary-capture-finding.json')
    need(type(first['outer_status']) is int and first['outer_status'] == 1 and first['started'] is False
         and first['reader_terminal'] is None and not (BASE / 'semantic-positive-started.json').exists(),
         'binary writer preflight refusal retains without invented reader execution')
    normal = read('recovery-normal-commit.json')
    need(type(normal['status']) is int and normal['status'] == 0
         and '[doctrine] all doctrine checks passed' in normal['stdout'] + normal['stderr'], 'complete committed recovery normal-hook prerequisite')
    candidate = dict(source=source, contracts=contracts, native=rows)
    join(candidate, source, contracts)
    mutations = [
        ('omitted original obligation', lambda c: c['contracts']['nodes'].pop(RAW + '.5.2'), 'every unchanged original parent and descendant obligation'),
        ('Boolean native terminal', lambda c: c['native']['checkpoint-core'].update(status=False), 'typed successful current gate checkpoint-core'),
        ('omitted source', lambda c: c['source']['members'].pop(next(iter(source['members']))), 'complete original source join')]
    controls = []
    for name, mutation, cause in mutations:
        changed = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
        mutation(changed)
        try:
            join(changed, source, contracts)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error) == cause, 'actual intended complete parent join refusal')
            controls.append(dict(name=name, cause=str(error)))
        else:
            raise ValueError('changed complete parent join accepted: ' + name)
    return dict(owner=OWNER, source=pin(canonical(source)), contracts=contracts,
                native={n: pin(canonical(r)) for n, r in rows.items()}, controls=controls,
                condition=PLAN['condition'],
                legs=dict(rederive='Complete fixed Git/source custody, original whole checkpoint/recovery predicates, and actual source-first semantic reconstruction.',
                          falsify='Original complete semantic/context/recovery counterexamples retain under unchanged source bodies; genuine whole parent obligation/status/source interventions reach their intended predicates.',
                          durability='Whole committed native products and first failures, strict complete source modes/membership, unchanged original contracts and separately captured current metadata terminals. No ignored view or original native reexecution is required.'))


def publication():
    row = read('publication.json')
    snapshots = {}
    for name, epochs in row['snapshots'].items():
        snapshots[name] = {}
        for role, entry in epochs.items():
            body = gzip.decompress(Path(entry['snapshot']).read_bytes())
            need(pin(body) == entry['identity'], 'whole parent publication snapshot')
            snapshots[name][role] = body
        need(Path(name).read_bytes() == snapshots[name]['after'], 'whole current parent publication source')
    old = nodes(git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK))
    final = nodes(snapshots[TASK]['after'])
    need(old.keys() == final.keys(), 'whole original task population after parent acceptance')
    for key in old:
        need(all(field(old[key], name) == field(final[key], name) for name in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children')), 'every whole original task contract conserves')
        if key in CLOSE:
            need(field(final[key], 'Status') == 'done', 'only selected complete raw semantic owners close')
        else:
            need(old[key] == final[key], 'all unrelated original nodes conserve whole')
    before = snapshots[BOOK]['before']
    need(before == git('show', REVISION + ':' + BOOK)
         and snapshots[BOOK]['after'] == before.replace(row['old_notice'].encode(), row['notice'].encode(), 1).replace(row['old_association'].encode(), row['association'].encode(), 1),
         'exact bounded own status and historical association wording changes')
    need(len(snapshots[BOOK]['after']) <= 292485, 'unchanged actual book allowance')
    return {name: pin(epochs['after']) for name, epochs in snapshots.items()}


def catalogue():
    return {p.name: dict(**pin(p.read_bytes()), executable=bool(p.stat().st_mode & 0o111))
            for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.name not in EXCLUDED}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--core', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--seal', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(not (args.core and args.seal), 'one explicit original acceptance qualification role')
    result = core()
    if args.core:
        print('PASS complete original parent contract/source/native join and genuine separating controls.')
        return
    result['publication'] = publication()
    commands = {'publication': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'publish.py')],
                'focused': ['prove', '-v', 't/2067-record-value-gate-streams.t', 't/1549-task-tree-integrity-doctrine.t',
                            't/1636-claim-verification-doctrine.t', 't/1303-isf-public-live-book-paths-audit.t', 't/1305-isf-book-feature-matrix-audit.t'],
                'book': ['mdbook', 'build', 'docs/book'],
                'native': ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', '--build', 'docs/book/book'],
                'size': ['scripts/check_live_document_size.sh'], 'claims': ['scripts/check_claim_verification.pl'],
                'inventory-write': ['scripts/check_claim_verification_inventory.pl', '--write'],
                'inventory': ['scripts/check_claim_verification_inventory.pl']}
    result['external'] = {n: pin(canonical(gate(n, cmd))) for n, cmd in commands.items()}
    need('All tests successful' in read('focused-actual.json')['stdout'], 'complete focused regression native success')
    if args.seal:
        save('proof.json', result)
        save('manifest.json', catalogue())
    else:
        need(read('proof.json') == result and read('manifest.json') == catalogue(), 'complete committed-state-only parent qualification')
    print(SUCCESS, end='')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Restore missing audit gate streams from explicit, unchanged committed receipts."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import stat
import subprocess

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def relative(value, allow_dot=False):
    require(type(value) is str and value and '\\' not in value and '\x00' not in value
            and '\n' not in value and '\r' not in value, 'ordinary relative path text')
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    require(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts)
            and path.as_posix() == value and (value != '.' or allow_dot),
            'canonical repository-relative path')
    return Path(value)


def local(path):
    """Read-only preflight; never create a directory or follow a link."""
    current = REPO
    device = REPO.stat().st_dev
    for index, part in enumerate(path.parts):
        current = current / part
        require(not current.is_symlink(), 'symlink boundary refused')
        if current.exists():
            info = current.lstat()
            require(info.st_dev == device, 'same-volume boundary required')
            require(index == len(path.parts) - 1 or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode),
                    'ordinary directory ancestor required')
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                require(not os.path.lexists(current / '.git'), 'nested Git boundary refused')
    return current


def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        require(key not in result, 'duplicate receipt object key')
        result[key] = value
    return result


def committed_receipts(names):
    result = []
    for name in names:
        path = relative(name)
        require(len(path.parts) == 4 and path.parts[:2] == ('docs', 'audits')
                and path.name == 'checks.json', 'explicit audit checks receipt required')
        descriptor = os.open(local(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as stream:
            before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_dev == REPO.stat().st_dev,
                    'ordinary same-volume committed receipt file required')
            raw = stream.read()
            after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            require((before.st_ino, before.st_dev, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                    (after.st_ino, after.st_dev, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
                    and len(raw) == before.st_size, 'complete stable committed receipt read')
        native = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO), '--no-replace-objects',
                                 'show', 'HEAD:' + name], capture_output=True)
        require(type(native.returncode) is int and native.returncode == 0
                and native.stderr == b'' and native.stdout == raw,
                'complete receipt must match committed HEAD bytes')
        records = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_object)
        require(type(records) is dict and records, 'complete named gate receipt object')
        result.append((name, records))
    return result


def plan(receipts, root='.'):
    """Validate every source, target and existing body before any filesystem write."""
    root_path = relative(root, allow_dot=True)
    require(local(root_path).is_dir(), 'existing ordinary destination root required')
    targets = {}
    for name, records in receipts:
        source = relative(name)
        require(len(source.parts) == 4 and source.parts[:2] == ('docs', 'audits')
                and source.name == 'checks.json', 'explicit audit checks receipt required')
        namespace = source.parts[2]
        require(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', namespace) is not None,
                'ordinary audit namespace required')
        require(type(records) is dict and records, 'complete named gate receipt object')
        for label, row in records.items():
            require(type(label) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', label) is not None
                    and type(row) is dict and type(row.get('status')) is int,
                    'complete typed terminal gate required')
            for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
                require(type(row.get(stream)) is str and type(row.get(stream + '_path')) is str,
                        'complete stream text and path required')
                path = relative(row[stream + '_path'])
                expected = Path('.artifacts') / namespace / 'checks' / label / (stream + '.txt')
                require(path == expected, 'stream path must match its declared audit gate')
                body = row[stream].encode('utf-8')
                target = root_path / path
                key = target.as_posix()
                if key in targets:
                    require(targets[key]['body'] == body, 'contradictory duplicate stream target')
                else:
                    targets[key] = dict(path=target, body=body)
    for row in targets.values():
        target = local(row['path'])
        row['present'] = target.exists()
        if row['present']:
            info = target.lstat()
            require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1,
                    'existing stream must be an ordinary unshared file')
            require(target.read_bytes() == row['body'], 'existing stream bytes conflict')
    return [targets[name] for name in sorted(targets)]


@contextlib.contextmanager
def parent_directory(path):
    """Open each directory without following links, including during installation."""
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    descriptors = [os.open(REPO, flags)]
    device = os.fstat(descriptors[0]).st_dev
    try:
        for part in path.parts:
            parent = descriptors[-1]
            try:
                child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=parent)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                os.mkdir(part, mode=0o700, dir_fd=parent)
                child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=parent)
            descriptors.append(child)
            require(os.fstat(child).st_dev == device, 'same-volume directory required at installation')
            try:
                os.stat('.git', dir_fd=child, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ValueError('nested Git boundary refused at installation')
        yield descriptors[-1]
    finally:
        for descriptor in reversed(descriptors):
            os.close(descriptor)


def install(rows):
    created = []
    for row in rows:
        if row['present']:
            continue
        path, body = row['path'], row['body']
        with parent_directory(path.parent) as directory:
            temporary = '.restore-stream-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
            descriptor = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                 0o600, dir_fd=directory)
            try:
                with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'wb') as stream:
                    stream.write(body)
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                # A complete body becomes visible atomically; an existing target is never replaced.
                os.link(temporary, path.name, src_dir_fd=directory, dst_dir_fd=directory,
                        follow_symlinks=False)
                created.append(path.as_posix())
            finally:
                os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=directory)
    return created


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--receipts', nargs='+', required=True,
                        help='explicit committed docs/audits/NAMESPACE/checks.json sources')
    parser.add_argument('--root', default='.', help='existing ordinary repository-relative destination root')
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true', help='require all exact streams without writing')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    receipts = committed_receipts(args.receipts)
    rows = plan(receipts, args.root)
    if args.check:
        require(all(row['present'] for row in rows), 'complete streams not yet materialized')
        created = []
    else:
        created = install(rows)
    after = plan(receipts, args.root)
    require(all(row['present'] for row in after), 'complete exact stream installation required')
    print(json.dumps(dict(root=args.root, sources=args.receipts, created=created,
        streams=[dict(path=row['path'].as_posix(), bytes=len(row['body']),
                      sha256=hashlib.sha256(row['body']).hexdigest()) for row in after],
        condition='Exact committed text only; no reader execution, status reinterpretation or native/private qualification.'),
        sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (ValueError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
        raise SystemExit('gate-stream-recovery: ' + str(error))

"""Permanent filesystem and receipt controls for missing-only stream recovery."""
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('stream_recovery', REPO / 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
SOURCE = 'docs/audits/test-gates/checks.json'


def records(label='one', text='exact\n'):
    return {label: dict(status=0, stdout=text, stderr='',
        stdout_path='.artifacts/test-gates/checks/' + label + '/stdout.txt',
        stderr_path='.artifacts/test-gates/checks/' + label + '/stderr.txt')}


class StreamRecovery(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        base = recovery.local(Path('.artifacts/gate-stream-tests'))
        base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='case-', dir=base)
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name).relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
        self.folder = REPO / self.root

    def census(self):
        return {p.relative_to(self.folder).as_posix(): (p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else None)
                for p in self.folder.rglob('*') if not p.is_symlink()}

    def refused(self, candidate, reason, sources=None):
        before = self.census()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, reason):

    def test_real_committed_receipt_cli_check_and_replay(self):
        command = ['python3', '-B', str(REPO / 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py'),
                   '--receipts', 'docs/audits/raw-association-acceptance-20261011/checks.json', '--root', self.root]
        before = subprocess.run(command + ['--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(before.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('complete streams not yet materialized', before.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.census(), {})
        first = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual((first.returncode, first.stderr), (0, ''))
        result = json.loads(first.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(result['created'])
        source = recovery.committed_receipts(['docs/audits/raw-association-acceptance-20261011/checks.json'])
        expected = recovery.plan(source, self.root)
        self.assertEqual(len(result['streams']), len(expected))
        second = subprocess.run(command + ['--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        third = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual((second.returncode, second.stderr, third.returncode, third.stderr), (0, '', 0, ''))
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(third.stdout)['created'], [])
